scripts.db:migrate: cd id-creator-server/Server && dotnet ef database update
scripts.infra:start: cd id-creator-server/Server && docker compose -f up -d rabbitmq
scripts.install: npm run frontend:install && npm run backend:install
scripts.setup: npm run db:start && npm run infra:start && npm run db:migrate
scripts.start: npm run frontend:start & npm run backend:start
scripts.test: npm run frontend:test && npm run backend:test
scripts.lint: npm run frontend:lint && npm run backend:lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm run frontend:lint:fix && npm run backend:lint:fix
